title: Vertical pack manifest (verticals/<id>/pack.json)
description: Contract every vertical pack must satisfy. vertical.py enforces the required keys at load time; this document is the reference for pack authors and, later, the setup frontend.

required_intake_fields.description: Client-config fields that must be present and non-empty for a client to boot on this pack.

publish_exact_location.description: SAFETY-CRITICAL polarity flag. false: locations are generalized (town centroid pins, GPS stripped) — right for customer-privacy verticals. true: the exact location is the point of the page — right for verticals where the address is public on purpose. Never inferred; always declared.

prompts.description: Relative paths to prompt files. observe = pass-1 system prompt (static). write/area = {{placeholder}} templates rendered per client.

schemas.description: Relative paths to JSON-schema files. The page schema may use "$client.<slot>" enum references resolved per client; empty resolution fails the boot.

jsonld.description: Relative path to the Schema.org template. String values of the form "$<context>.<field>" resolve against {client, page, service, computed}.

compliance_floor.description: Relative path to {"blocklist": [{pattern, reason}, ...]}. Applied to every client on this pack IN ADDITION to the client's own rules — a client config can add but never remove.
